# Index {.unnumbered}

Terms of the book, each with a one-line definition and the sections that use
it.

::: {#term-common-factor .tp-entry}
**common factor**: an unobserved variable that moves every unit at once, each
with its own loading.

Used in: @sec-exponent, @sec-second-gen, @sec-cd-power.
:::

::: {#term-cross-sectional-dependence .tp-entry}
**cross-sectional dependence**: correlation between the errors of different
units in the same period.

Used in: @sec-dependence, @sec-cd-test, @sec-cd-theory.
:::

::: {#term-unit-root .tp-entry}
**unit root**: a series whose shocks never die out, so it wanders without a
fixed mean.

Used in: @sec-unit-roots, @sec-ips, @sec-cips.
:::
